# Spec & Plan Quality Checklist: Run Detail Page

**Purpose**: Validate that the feature's spec (`spec.md`) and plan (`plan.md`) are complete, consistent, unambiguous, and testable — a requirements-quality review of what is *written*, not of the implementation.
**Created**: 2026-09-18
**Feature**: [spec.md](../spec.md) · [plan.md](../plan.md)

**Note**: This custom checklist is generated by the `/speckit-checklist` command based on feature context and requirements.
**Review Ownership**: This checklist is a reviewer-owned requirements-quality review artifact. Mark an item `[x]` only when the reviewer determines the requirements-quality criterion is satisfied.
**Marker Semantics**: `[x]` means the criterion has been reviewed and satisfied for requirements quality. It does not mean implementation work is complete.

**Scope of this review**: spec + plan for feature 017 (branch `207-ui-run-detail-page`).
**Depth**: Formal PR-review gate (thorough). **Audience**: Reviewer at PR review.

## Requirement Completeness

- [ ] CHK001 - Is every one of the five sections (Summary, Output, Checks, Context, Transcript) backed by at least one functional requirement describing its content? [Completeness, Spec §FR-001..FR-034]
- [ ] CHK002 - Are default open/closed states specified for all five sections, with no section left unstated? [Completeness, Spec §FR-002]
- [ ] CHK003 - Is the source-precedence chain for the Summary fully enumerated for all three cases (report notes, event text, neither)? [Completeness, Spec §FR-008]
- [ ] CHK004 - Are requirements defined for all three produced-elsewhere kinds (pull request, commit, file), including the exact evidence that qualifies each? [Completeness, Spec §FR-011, §FR-012]
- [ ] CHK005 - Is the closed-state note content specified for every section (Summary, Output, Checks, Context, Transcript)? [Completeness, Spec §FR-009, §FR-014, §FR-017/018, §FR-020, §FR-034]
- [ ] CHK006 - Are the requirements for what STAYS in the configuration rail (and what leaves it) fully listed? [Completeness, Spec §FR-006, §FR-019]
- [ ] CHK007 - Does the spec state which existing page elements (header, stat strip, six stats) must remain unchanged, so "unchanged" is verifiable rather than assumed? [Completeness, Spec §FR-005]
- [ ] CHK008 - Are the design-system deliverables enumerated (which new components must land as macros first)? [Completeness, Spec §FR-037; Plan §"New/changed surface"]
- [ ] CHK009 - Does the plan identify every file the feature touches, with each mapped to a requirement or decision? [Completeness, Plan §"New/changed surface (files this feature touches)"]
- [ ] CHK010 - Are accessibility requirements (focusable, Enter/Space, `aria-expanded`) stated for BOTH the section headers and the tool-row expand control? [Completeness, Spec §FR-003, §FR-025]

## Requirement Clarity & Unambiguity

- [ ] CHK011 - Is the clamp height defined with a concrete value rather than a vague term ("a few lines")? [Clarity, Spec §FR-024; Assumption "Clamp height is fixed at 3 lines"]
- [ ] CHK012 - Are the terms `exit N` and `failed` each given precise trigger conditions (recorded exit code; missing result or permission refusal)? [Clarity, Spec §FR-022, §FR-027]
- [ ] CHK013 - Is the markdown "safe subset" for the Summary enumerated exactly, with unsupported content behaviour stated? [Clarity, Spec §FR-007]
- [ ] CHK014 - Is "produced elsewhere" evidence defined precisely enough to be recognised in an event stream (e.g. "GitHub `201` carrying an `html_url`", "short SHA")? [Clarity, Spec §FR-011]
- [ ] CHK015 - Is the persistence scope unambiguous — shared per browser across all runs, not keyed per run id? [Clarity, Spec §FR-004; Clarifications 2026-09-18]
- [ ] CHK016 - Is the ordering rule for produced-elsewhere rows unambiguous (grouped by kind, then event-stream order within kind)? [Clarity, Spec §FR-012; Clarifications 2026-09-18]
- [ ] CHK017 - Is the head-line description fallback order for tool cards fully specified (call description → file path → arg summary)? [Clarity, Spec §FR-023]
- [ ] CHK018 - Is the closed-state note format for counts specified precisely enough to be reproduced ("0 files · 1 pull request", show each part only when non-zero)? [Clarity, Spec §FR-014, §FR-018]

## Requirement Consistency

- [ ] CHK019 - Do the spec's FR set and the plan's "Planning decisions" agree on every decision (clamp=3, shared localStorage key, source precedence, mining heuristics)? [Consistency, Spec §FR-* vs Plan §"Planning decisions"]
- [ ] CHK020 - Is the persistence rule consistent across FR-004, FR-028 (per-section state persists; expand-all is view-only and does not persist)? [Consistency, Spec §FR-004, §FR-028]
- [ ] CHK021 - Are the sections' default states stated identically wherever they appear (User Story 1, FR-002, Success Criteria SC-001)? [Consistency, Spec §US1, §FR-002, §SC-001]
- [ ] CHK022 - Does the "presentation and read-path only, no run-record change" constraint appear consistently in the spec, the plan Summary, and the Constitution Check without contradiction? [Consistency, Spec §FR-035; Plan §Summary, §"Constitution Check"]
- [ ] CHK023 - Do the closed-state note wordings in the spec Assumptions match those cited in the plan's Planning decision 8? [Consistency, Spec §Assumptions vs Plan §"Planning decisions" #8]
- [ ] CHK024 - Is the branch/directory naming discrepancy (`207-...` branch vs `017-...` directory) reconciled so both refer to one feature without ambiguity? [Consistency, Plan §"Directory/branch note"]
- [ ] CHK025 - Are the rail contents described consistently between FR-006 and FR-019 and User Story 6 AC-3 (same set, same order)? [Consistency, Spec §FR-006, §FR-019, §US6-AC3]

## Acceptance Criteria & Testability

- [ ] CHK026 - Does every functional requirement have at least one acceptance scenario or success criterion that can objectively confirm it? [Measurability, Spec §FR-001..§FR-037 vs §"Acceptance Scenarios", §SC-001..§SC-010]
- [ ] CHK027 - Are the Success Criteria (SC-001..SC-010) each objectively verifiable without reference to a specific implementation? [Measurability, Spec §SC-001..§SC-010]
- [ ] CHK028 - Is a concrete reference run identified so the acceptance checks are reproducible? [Measurability, Spec §Assumptions "Reference content"; §SC-001, §SC-003]
- [ ] CHK029 - Can "renders as formatted text with no raw markup visible" be objectively checked (e.g. against a golden fixture)? [Measurability, Spec §SC-003, §FR-007; Plan §"Planning decisions" #2]
- [ ] CHK030 - Are the theme-conformance expectations (light, dark, Indigo; fade follows background token) measurable rather than subjective? [Measurability, Spec §SC-009]
- [ ] CHK031 - Is "the UI test suite passes in full, including design-system conformance" backed by named, existing test surfaces in the plan? [Measurability, Spec §SC-010; Plan §"Tests under ui/tests/"]

## Scenario & Edge-Case Coverage

- [ ] CHK032 - Are empty-state requirements defined for every section (no output artifacts, no checks, no final message, empty section note)? [Coverage, Spec §FR-008, §FR-014, §FR-017; §"Edge Cases"]
- [ ] CHK033 - Is the behaviour specified when persistence (localStorage) is unavailable (fall back to defaults, no error)? [Coverage, Edge Case, Spec §FR-004; §"Edge Cases"]
- [ ] CHK034 - Is the diff-in-clamped-OUT-row edge case resolved with a stated fallback (expand diff cards by default)? [Coverage, Exception Flow, Spec §FR-026; §"Edge Cases"]
- [ ] CHK035 - Is the "older event stream cannot be mined" recovery path specified (show file list / "No output artifacts" alone)? [Coverage, Recovery, Spec §FR-013; §"Edge Cases"]
- [ ] CHK036 - Is the search-vs-clamp interaction specified (a card matching only on clamped IN/OUT auto-expands during search and reverts on clear)? [Coverage, Spec §FR-029; Clarifications 2026-09-18]
- [ ] CHK037 - Is the duplicate final-message case (last assistant message and final event carry the same text) resolved to a single Result entry? [Coverage, Edge Case, Spec §FR-032]
- [ ] CHK038 - Is the mixed case (output files AND a produced-elsewhere PR) addressed so both appear and the note counts both? [Coverage, Spec §FR-014; §"Edge Cases"]

## Non-Functional Requirements

- [ ] CHK039 - Are design-system conformance constraints stated as testable requirements (tokens only, no literal colours/pixels, no inline styles, macro-composed)? [NFR, Spec §FR-036, §SC-010; Constitution VII]
- [ ] CHK040 - Are graceful-degradation/performance requirements specified for when Dagster is unreachable (Checks degrade to "—"; page still renders disk-only)? [NFR, Plan §"Performance/Constraints"; Spec §FR-017]
- [ ] CHK041 - Is the raw-transcript size bound (512 KB) stated so it is not left as an implicit assumption? [NFR, Plan §"Performance/Constraints"]

## Dependencies & Assumptions

- [ ] CHK042 - Are the reuse assumptions (file-row macro, Agents-overview Checks treatment, context card, raw-log view, `dagster.run_status`) documented and validated as existing? [Assumption, Spec §Assumptions; Plan §"Planning decisions" #5]
- [ ] CHK043 - Is the "no new dependency / no markdown library" decision recorded so the Summary renderer's scope is bounded? [Dependency, Plan §"Primary Dependencies"]
- [ ] CHK044 - Are the "made unattended" planning decisions each traceable to a spec requirement or clarification rather than introducing unstated scope? [Assumption, Plan §"Planning decisions (made unattended)"]
- [ ] CHK045 - Is the out-of-scope boundary explicit enough (compare page untouched, Runs overview untouched, no streaming, no new check types, no cost data) to prevent scope creep? [Assumption, Spec §"Out of Scope", §FR-035]

## Ambiguities & Conflicts

- [ ] CHK046 - Does the spec resolve the "exit code but not stored in event schema" tension, stating that `exit N` is derived best-effort and may be absent? [Ambiguity, Spec §FR-022; §"Edge Cases"; Plan §"Planning decisions" #6]
- [ ] CHK047 - Is there any conflict between "Summary shows only the final message" (Assumption) and any FR implying Summary carries stats? [Conflict, Spec §Assumptions, §FR-007..§FR-009]
- [ ] CHK048 - Is a requirement/acceptance-criteria ID scheme established and applied consistently (FR-### and SC-###) so every item is traceable? [Traceability, Spec §"Functional Requirements", §"Success Criteria"]
